scope: Same-page instructor event scheduling in the built-in fixed-step world; no remote roles, student permissions, native flight-controller injection or hardware validation.

coverage: Strict 1–64 event plans, future tick bounds, airframe and motor index validation, JSON import/export and atomic rejection
Ordered same-tick fault/recovery/wind execution, speed and selection independence, pause and inspection lease freeze
Cancellation, reset, stale import epoch, callback failure pause and manual continuation without resuming failed schedule
Real Worker VTOL motor and pusher events, exact schema16 native event recording and replay
Collision/DEM/byte/time/event caps cancel remaining events; terminal API application rejected without state mutation

denseFourVehicle.note: Whole final world frame may cross the byte cap; remaining instructor events are cancelled.

catalog.note: Counts describe catalogue entries, not market coverage.

limitations: Sensor faults remain independent observations and do not feed an EKF or the ideal built-in controller.
Cancelling future events does not restore existing faults, wind or flight mode. Link recovery requires an explicit mode change to leave a latched safety return/landing.
Flight recording stores actual commands only; pending plans and instructor reports are separate exports.
No physical HIL, external SITL, remote instructor or student access isolation tested in this release.
